interface.signature: def findKthNumber(n: int, k: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers where k is at least 1, at most n, and n is at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in [findKthNumber(n, k)])
postconditions.description: The returned integer is within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: len([x for x in range(1, n + 1) if str(x) < str(findKthNumber(n, k))]) < k - 1
postconditions.description: There are exactly k-1 integers in [1, n] whose string representation is lexicographically smaller than the returned integer.

postconditions.expression: len([x for x in range(1, n + 1) if str(x) == str(findKthNumber(n, k))]) == 1
postconditions.description: The returned integer is unique in the lexicographical ordering of [1, n].
